description: Shows the team's Brand Kit: tone, voice words, words to use and avoid, emoji and hashtag rules, audience, offers, disclaimer, banned claims, review mode and content mix. Use when the user asks how AI social copy sounds, what the brand rules are, or before changing them. Not for brand colours or the team profile (use get_team_profile). Returns every Brand Kit field with defaults applied.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.
